Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Put your hands together and let’s hand it to artist Rope Arrow because these hand-drawn, hand-written cards are hands-down some of the handiest you could ever draw into your hand. Hands up… Who would love to get their hands on them? If these cards would be in safe hands in your collection or you just want to try your hand at playing with them, we’re happy to hand them over. Okay. This is getting out of hand. Apologizes for being so heavy-handed.?
Contents:
• 1x Foil Poster Eldrazi Conscription
• 1x Foil Poster Deafening Silence
• 1x Foil Poster Counterbalance
• 1x Foil Poster Bruna, Light of Alabaster
